name: AI-Powered Product Description Generator – AI Product Tools for WooCommerce
author: Dogu Pekgoz

sections.description:
🚀 Revolutionize Your E-commerce Content Creation

AI Product Tools is your ultimate AI-powered assistant that transforms the way you create product descriptions for WooCommerce. Leveraging cutting-edge AI technology from industry leaders like OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Google’s Gemini AI, this plugin helps you generate compelling, SEO-friendly product descriptions in seconds.

🌟 Why Choose AI Product Tools?

  • 🤖 Dual AI Integration: Choose between OpenAI (ChatGPT) or Google’s Gemini AI
  • ⚡ Lightning Fast: Generate descriptions in seconds, not hours
  • 🌍 Multi-Language Support: Create content in any language
  • 📱 Mobile-Friendly: Work from any device
  • 🔒 Secure: Your data and API keys are always protected
  • 🎯 SEO-Optimized: AI-generated content designed for better search rankings

Features

  • ✅ Multiple AI Providers

    • OpenAI (ChatGPT) Integration
    • Google Gemini AI Integration
    • Easy provider switching
    • Flexible API key management

  • ✅ Advanced Content Generation

    • Long Product Descriptions
    • Short Product Descriptions
    • Custom Prompts
    • Brand Voice Customization

  • ✅ Customization Options

    • Language Selection
    • Writing Style Selection
    • Length Control
    • Product Attribute Integration

  • ✅ Smart Features

    • Bulk Generation Support
    • Category-aware Descriptions
    • Price-sensitive Content
    • SKU Integration
    • Tag-based Generation

Third-Party Supported Integrations

AI Product Tools seamlessly integrates with leading AI providers to deliver the best possible content generation experience:

OpenAI (ChatGPT):

  • GPT-4 Turbo
  • GPT-4
  • GPT-3.5 Turbo
    For more information, visit OpenAI API Models

Google Gemini AI:

  • Gemini Pro
  • Gemini Pro Vision
    For more information, visit Google Gemini AI

Service Terms and Privacy Policies

For detailed information on the terms of use and privacy policies of these services, please visit:
– OpenAI Terms and OpenAI Privacy Policy
– Google AI Terms and Google Privacy Policy

Disclaimer

AI Product Tools is a plugin that enables users to utilize API services from OpenAI and Google Gemini AI. To use these services, users need to obtain their own API keys and comply with the respective service providers’ terms of use. Users are responsible for monitoring and managing AI-generated content and addressing any potential misuse. The AI Product Tools developer and associated parties are not liable for any issues or losses arising from the use of the plugin or AI-generated content. Users should consult legal professionals and comply with local regulations.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ‘ai-product-tools.zip’ to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate AI Product Tools from the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Choose your preferred AI provider (OpenAI or Gemini AI)
  4. Enter and save your API key
  5. Customize your settings
  6. Go to any WooCommerce product and click edit
  7. Use the “Generate Product Description” button
  8. Review and save your product
sections.faq:
Is the AI Product Tools plugin free?

Yes! The core features are 100% free. You only need an API key from your chosen provider (OpenAI or Google Gemini AI).

Which AI provider should I choose?

Both OpenAI and Gemini AI offer excellent results. OpenAI (ChatGPT) is known for its creative writing, while Gemini AI often provides more structured, technical content. Try both to see which better suits your needs!

Do I need an API Key?

Yes, you’ll need an API key from either OpenAI or Google Gemini AI, depending on your chosen provider.

Can I customize the AI-generated descriptions?

Absolutely! You can customize:
– AI Provider selection
– Language preferences
– Writing style
– Description length
– Custom prompts
– And much more!

Is it SEO-friendly?

Yes! The generated descriptions are optimized for search engines while maintaining readability and engagement.
